name: INEC Continuous Voter Registration portal: polling unit locator (state, LGA and registration area lists)
notes: Current official codes and names for 37 states, 774 LGAs and registration areas. The live list holds 8,810 registration areas because one ward (Gwer East, Benue, code 09 Mbaikyaan) appears twice; without the duplicate the total is 8,809, matching INEC's published figure.

name: INEC polling units statistics
notes: Publishes the totals 176,846 polling units, 8,809 registration areas and 774 LGAs.

name: INEC Directory of Polling Units, revised January 2015 (one PDF per state)
notes: Removed from inecnigeria.org; the official files were retrieved from the Internet Archive (35 of 37 states; Abia and Delta were not archived). Used to cross-check ward codes and names and to repair typing errors in the live list.

name: Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999, First Schedule (Parts I and II)
publisher: Federal Republic of Nigeria (copy hosted by the National Human Rights Commission)
notes: State capitals, FCT area council headquarters, the legal total of 768 LGAs plus 6 area councils, and historical spellings. This copy is a retyped transcription with typing errors, so it is not used as the master list of LGA names.

name: Nigeria - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB)
publisher: OCHA, from the Office of the Surveyor General of the Federation (OSGOF), eHealth Africa and the UN Cartographic Section
notes: Dataset last modified 2026-04-16. P-codes, centroid coordinates, senatorial districts and LGA headquarters (admin capitals). Known errors found: Anambra capital spelled 'Akwa', 'Obia/Akpor' for Obio/Akpor, 'Markafi' for Makarfi; LGA headquarters are single-source and marked unverified.

name: geoBoundaries gbOpen NGA ADM1 and ADM2
notes: ADM1 has 37 units and ADM2 has 774. Reserved for the optional boundaries package.

name: Country Guidance: Nigeria (2021), General remarks
notes: Lists the six geopolitical zones and their states, with the FCT in North-Central. No Nigerian government page listing the zones was found.

name: Full list: 36 Nigerian states, their dates of creation and how they were created
notes: Single secondary source, so creation dates are marked unverified. It dates Anambra to 1991 (when old Anambra was split) but Imo to 1976, so 'creation date' is ambiguous for states that were later split or renamed.

name: CBN lists of financial institutions (via the cbn.gov.ng/api endpoints behind the supervision pages)
notes: Commercial (28), merchant (5), non-interest (6), payment service banks (5), mobile money operators (16), microfinance (796), primary mortgage (33) and development finance institutions (8). Names, types and licensed status only.

name: Revised Standards on Nigeria Uniform Bank Account Number (NUBAN) for Banks and Other Financial Institutions
publisher: Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), Payments System Management Department
notes: The document is dated 2019 although published under /2020/. Check-digit weights 3,7,3,3,7,3,...; bank codes padded to 6 digits with zeros, OFI codes prefixed with 9. Worked examples: 0000014579 (bank 011) and 0000214579 (OFI 50547).

name: Paystack public bank list (GET /bank?country=nigeria)
notes: 288 entries. Its 'code' field mixes CBN codes, NIP codes and provider-specific codes (e.g. 'MFB50094', '035A'); only codes whose shape fits the institution type are used.

name: Monnify public bank list
notes: 31 entries with CBN code, NIP code and USSD code. Still lists Diamond and Heritage banks, so it is never used for status.

name: CBN press release: revocation of the banking licence of Heritage Bank Plc
Access Bank launches new brand following its merger with Diamond Bank
Merger: Access, Diamond Banks get final approval from CBN
NCC Mobile Number Allocation Table
notes: Allocations as at December 2023; page updated 2024-11-25. Mobile number portability means a prefix shows the original network, not always the current one.

name: NIPOST National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode System
notes: Launched 2026-10-01. 11-character codes such as FC02A09DB09 (State, LGA, District, Area, Building). Lookups go through a gated API, so only the format is described here.
